topic: Weekly earnings for a tutor based on sessions and rate per session
core_question: A math tutor earns $25 per session and teaches 6 sessions a week. Find the tutor's weekly earnings. (secondary: Two friends share a $58 bill. One agrees to pay $12 more than the other because they ordered a bigger meal. How much does the person paying less owe?)
answer_summary: the total of $150 (6 sessions a week at $25 per session); after the topic shift: the smaller share of $23 (the other friend pays $35, $12 more)
persona: dramatic and exasperated; using casual slang
